findings.problem: observe_regular first read/open/close bypasses Owner descriptor slots, pending/busy/fail and aggregate accounting. A read exception followed by a close exception loses the primary raw exception; owner remains reusable and partial bytes/FD are untracked. First pass precedes the retained_read budget and its captured state.
findings.smallest_correction: Perform the actual observation through the same single owned descriptor state machine, with observed hash explicitly non-authoritative; retain raw primary/secondary failures and partial bytes and consume/quarantine uncertainty. Eliminate unowned preliminary pass.

findings.problem: kind in (list,dict) can invoke foreign metaclass __eq__ while validating a foreign instance; this violates exact callback-free domain validation. Counterexample: class Foreign with metaclass defining incrementing/raising __eq__, then plain(Foreign()).
findings.smallest_correction: Use identity checks for type-domain branches and serialize a new metaclass callback-count-zero fixture through the author.

findings.problem: validate_blob and observe_regular do not validate exact cap integer/range before comparisons. A foreign cap can invoke a comparison callback; oversize cap allows the unowned first read before retained_read rejects it.
findings.smallest_correction: Validate exact int cap in0..FILE_CAP at each externally callable validator/observer boundary before comparison or I/O.

findings.problem: path_text does not implement original schema.path ASCII printable-character or max64-component constraints. It accepts paths that later original receiver policy rejects.
findings.smallest_correction: Match original schema.path ASCII/printable/component limits before installation or publication.
